user.title: Connect Mealie Atelier Bridge
user.description: Your API token stays in Home Assistant. This extension complements the built-in Mealie integration and does not replace it.

data_description.url: The full address Home Assistant can reach, including http:// or https:// and the port, for example `http://192.168.1.20:9925`. For the Mealie Home Assistant app, use port 9090. Do not use an ingress or login URL.
data_description.api_token: Create a token in Mealie under User profile > API Tokens, then paste it here. Home Assistant stores it securely. It must never go in card YAML.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this enabled. Disable it only for a self-signed certificate on a trusted local network.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Mealie Atelier Bridge
reauth_confirm.description: Mealie rejected the saved API token of {account} ({url}). Create a new token in Mealie for this account under User profile > API Tokens and enter it here.

data_description.api_token: A new token for the same Mealie account. Find it in Mealie under User profile > API Tokens.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Mealie Atelier Bridge
reconfigure.description: Change the Mealie address or token. Home Assistant checks the connection before saving.

data_description.url: The full address Home Assistant can reach, including http:// or https:// and the port, for example `http://192.168.1.20:9925`. For the Mealie Home Assistant app, use port 9090. Do not use an ingress or login URL.
data_description.api_token: Optional. Leave empty to keep the saved token. Create a new token in Mealie under User profile > API Tokens. Home Assistant stores it securely.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this enabled. Disable it only for a self-signed certificate on a trusted local network.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the Mealie token.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http(s) Mealie URL, for example http://192.168.1.20:9925.
error.cannot_connect: Mealie is unreachable or returned an error.

abort.already_configured: This Mealie account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different Mealie account. Use a token of the account that was set up.

init.title: Security and interaction
init.description: Control what the dashboard may change and which optional services it can use.

data_description.read_only: Blocks all changes to recipes, meal plans, shopping lists, kitchen timers, the journal and pantry and family data. Useful for shared tablets, but timers then run only on the device.
data_description.write_users: Leave empty to let every Home Assistant user change shopping lists and meal plans. If you select at least one user, only the selected users and administrators can write. Administrators can always write. Select only administrators to allow administrators alone. Recipe editing stays admin only.
data_description.experimental_ingredient_edits: Lets administrators edit ingredients with linked foods and units. A backup is saved before every change.
data_description.usda_fdc_api_key: Optional. Only for the nutrition lab: the Bridge looks up ingredients in the free US food database FoodData Central and calculates nutrients per serving. For security the field never shows a saved key: leave it empty to keep it. Without a key only the nutrition lookup is off. Get a free key with your name and email at [fdc.nal.usda.gov/api-key-signup]({usda_signup_url}).
data_description.clear_fdc_key: Enable this and save to remove the key.
data_description.openai_api_key: Optional, billed per request. Unlocks three AI helpers you start yourself: English search terms in the nutrition lab, ingredient substitutions and the recipe check. They send ingredients and, depending on the helper, the recipe name, amounts and steps to OpenAI or Anthropic, depending on your key. Nutrients always come from FoodData Central and the AI never changes a recipe on its own. For security the field never shows a saved key: leave it empty to keep it, or use the option below to remove it. Get an OpenAI key at [platform.openai.com/api-keys]({openai_keys_url}) or an Anthropic key at [platform.claude.com/settings/keys]({anthropic_keys_url}). Anthropic keys start with sk-ant-.
data_description.clear_ai_key: Enable this and save to remove the key. AI is off afterwards.
data_description.timer_notify_service: Optional. A notify service such as notify.mobile_app_your_phone that receives a push message when a kitchen timer ends. Leave empty for in-app notifications only.

error.invalid_notify_service: Enter a notify service like notify.mobile_app_your_phone.
